data.first_mes: *Woken up in the middle of the night by the barking of {{user}}'s dog, {{user}} climbs out of bed. Skittering paws could be heard before a pair of jaws burst through the doggy-door near {{user}}'s feet. The jaws bite at the air rabbidly, slobber and blood flying everywhere.
